title: 第21章 必输之局第22章 强榜前十
content_zh:
叶祈安可是知道这妮子的恐怖性，看起来只有地元境初期而已。
要说火力全开，恐怕也只有内门一些长老，或者大长老才能匹敌吧？
而且这还是保守估计。
沈凝霜忽然转身对着叶祈安平静的说道。
“朱擎苍.....就交给我，马仟宇交给你没问题吧？”
叶祈安听后微微一笑，感情这妮子是在帮自己出气啊。
“放心，马仟宇交给我了，咱们约定好在内院相见。”
沈凝霜隐藏在面具下的惊世容颜也是嘴角微微一抿。
那就......相约好在内院相见。
不过沈凝霜并没有开口说出来，只是在内心微微一笑。
一长老见所有弟子抽签完毕，请示了一下大长老之后便大声说道。
“考核，正式开始。”
“哗啦！”
随着长老的话音落下，下方众多弟子纷纷爆发出阵阵喝彩的声音！
特别是一些杂役弟子，对于叶祈安的呼声甚至是盖过了三大世家支持的声音。
“叶平安，加油加油，相信你一定可以战胜马仟宇。”
“没错没错，替我们杂役弟子们涨涨志气！”
这一刻，就算是曾经许多针对叶祈安的杂役弟子都纷纷支持起来。
只因为叶祈安是苍澜学院这么久以来唯一一个以杂役弟子的身份直接挑战内门考核的！
绫轻烟和苏也两人小跑着走过来，看到叶祈安此时的爆火人气也不禁感叹说道。

“叶兄，你这人气简直是盖过了我的人气啊，就连绫姑娘的人气都被你盖过了。”苏也苦笑的摇头说道。
“叶平安，杂役弟子直接挑战内门考核，人气自然高。”绫轻烟平静的说道。
她眉目流转，眼神看向站在叶祈安旁边的沈凝霜。
此女...也是杂役弟子，何时出现了一个如此强大和神秘的绝美女子？
绫轻烟自诩在容貌上还是有几分自信的，但是一旦站在她的旁边，她才知道两者之间终究是有些差距。
这差距不是体现在外在美，而是那种静若天人和一尘不染的美。
人世间竟有如此气质的姑娘。
而阁楼的上方，朱擎苍看到他的未婚妻竟然主动跟叶平安搭话，让他心情顿时不爽。
这贱人，平日里对我爱搭不理，故作高冷，竟然对叶平安如此亲近。
朱擎苍这一刻对叶平安的恨意达到了巅峰。
这一刻，他改变主意了。
“马仟宇，待会你上场不用留手，直接弄死叶平安。”朱擎苍狠厉的说道。
“可是...这...死的了的话会不会...宗门们可是严禁下死手。”
“怕什么！出了事情有我朱家给你兜着。”
见马仟宇还是露出犹豫的表情，他再次说道。
“放心，先前给你许诺的好处直接翻双倍！”
“成！朱兄，算话算话，说好了出了事情你朱家兜底。”
“放心，我朱家族长都在大长老旁边。”
朱擎苍眼神阴冷的看向叶祈安，那挑衅的意味不言而喻。
而叶祈安自然是注意到有一股阴冷的目光时刻在盯着自己。

他内心冷笑一声，究竟谁才是谁的猎物，可还说不定.......
诺大的演武广场上一共有着二十五个比武台。
content_en:
Ye Qian knew how terrifying this girl was, she seemed to be in the early stage of Earth Yuan Realm.
In terms of full firepower, I'm afraid only some elders from the inner sect or the great elders can match it, right?
And this is still a conservative estimate.
Shen Ningshuang suddenly turned around and said calmly to Ye Qian'an.
"Zhu Qingcang...just leave it to me. Is it okay to leave Ma Qianyu to you?"
Ye Qian'an smiled slightly after hearing this, feeling that this girl was helping him vent his anger.
"Don't worry, Ma Qianyu left it to me. We have agreed to meet in the inner courtyard."
Shen Ningshuang's stunning face hidden under the mask also pursed her lips slightly.
Then... make an appointment to meet in the inner courtyard.
However, Shen Ningshuang didn't say it out loud, she just smiled in her heart.
When the first elder saw that all the disciples had finished drawing lots, he asked the great elder for instructions and then said loudly.
"The assessment has officially begun."
"Wow!"
As the elder's words fell, many disciples below burst into cheers!
Especially some handyman disciples, their voices for Ye Qian even overshadowed the voices of support from the three major aristocratic families.
"Ye Pingan, come on, come on, I believe you can defeat Ma Qianyu."
"That's right, that's right, boost the ambition of our handyman disciples!"
At this moment, even many of the handyman disciples who had targeted Ye Qian came to support him.
Just because Ye Qian is the only one in Canglan Academy who has directly challenged the inner sect examination as a handyman disciple for so long!
Ling Qingyan and Su Ye trotted over and couldn't help but sigh when they saw Ye Qian's explosive popularity at this time.
"Brother Ye, your popularity has simply surpassed my popularity. Even Miss Ling's popularity has been surpassed by you." Su Ye shook his head with a wry smile.
"Ye Pingan, the handyman disciple directly challenged the inner sect's assessment, so his popularity is naturally high." Ling Qingyan said calmly.
Her eyebrows moved and she looked at Shen Ningshuang who was standing next to Ye Qian'an.
This woman... is also a handyman disciple. When did such a powerful and mysterious and beautiful woman appear?
Ling Qingyan boasted that she was somewhat confident in her appearance, but once she stood next to her, she realized that there was some gap between the two.
This gap is not reflected in the external beauty, but in the kind of tranquil and spotless beauty.
There is a girl with such temperament in this world.
Above the attic, Zhu Qingcang saw that his fiancée actually took the initiative to talk to Ye Pingan, which made him feel unhappy.
This bitch, who usually ignores me and pretends to be aloof, is actually so close to Ye Pingan.
Zhu Qingcang's hatred for Ye Pingan reached its peak at this moment.
At this moment, he changed his mind.
"Ma Qianyu, don't hold back when you come on stage later, just kill Ye Ping'an directly." Zhu Qingcang said fiercely.
"But... if this... dies... the sects are strictly forbidden to kill him."
"What are you afraid of! If something happens, my Zhu family will take care of it for you."
Seeing that Ma Qianyu still showed hesitation, he said again.
"Don't worry, the benefits promised to you will be doubled!"
"Sure! Brother Zhu, keep your word. If anything happens, the Zhu family will take care of it."
"Don't worry, all the heads of my Zhu family are beside the great elder."
Zhu Qingcang looked at Ye Qian'an with cold eyes, and the provocative meaning was self-evident.
And Ye Qian naturally noticed that there was a cold gaze staring at him all the time.
He sneered in his heart. Who is whose prey? It's still unclear...
There are a total of twenty-five competition stages in Nuo University's martial arts square.
